role: Writes the block registry's static properties as the C header csrc/engine/blocks.h: a MATERIALS table (liquid, solid, blocks movement, burn, replaceable, opaque, tool, mobility), BLOCKS (opacity, light, class name, hardness, resistance, slipperiness, particle gravity, cube flags, random ticks and more) and FIRE_FLAM; read through the live Block objects, floats as hex literals.
